title: Ottawa's 2026 mayoral vote
subtitle: Every vote cast, placed in the voting place it came from.
about:
Results: City of Ottawa 2026 Statement of Votes Cast, by voting place. Ward advance votes are spread over each ward's voting places, and citywide special advance and mail-in votes over all voting places, in proportion to each candidate's election-day votes.

Where dots go: residential buildings (Statistics Canada National Address Register, June 2026) are assigned to the City's 2026 voting subdivisions; each voting place's votes are placed at its buildings in proportion to their residential units. Retirement-home and other voting places with no residential building are placed inside their own subdivision. Non-voters are not shown.

Dots sit at residential addresses; buildings with several dots spread them in a spiral. Zoom is capped so individual houses can't be picked out.
